title: Drowned Steeple
summary: A raymarched WebGL2 flooded stone belfry with a swinging lantern, directional ocean swells, rain ripples, and storm lightning.
description: A single-file WebGL2 SDF raymarching scene set around a partially submerged stone steeple rising from dark ocean swells, with wet moss, pointed lancet belfry openings, a swinging warm lantern, concentric raindrop ripples, mist, lightning flashes, and ACES bloom. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, press 1–3 for storm intensity, Right Drag or L to aim the light, R to reset, and Space to pause.
